title: Council adopts the 2026/27 'Invested in Hope' budget of R87.79bn
context: Total budget with R40bn three-year infrastructure programme protected despite tariff pressure.
outcome: Adopted. Capital programme ring-fenced; tariff package approved with relief bands.

title: R16.7bn water & sanitation capital allocation approved (40% of capex)
context: Largest single capital share, targeting pipe replacement, wastewater works and new supply.
outcome: Approved within the adopted budget. Delivery tracked via the pipe replacement programme.

title: Accelerate leak detection and zone metering in worst-loss supply zones
context: Non-revenue water trending toward 28%. Every percentage point is treated water paid for but never billed.
outcome: Crews re-deployed to top-loss zones; progress reads directly from the non-revenue water series.

title: Reprioritise capital toward preventative road resurfacing
context: Backlog projected to pass 1,715 km next period. Preventative resurfacing is 4-6x cheaper than rebuild after failure.

title: Record R6.8bn safety & security allocation, LEAP deployment sustained
context: Record allocation continuing investment in law enforcement capacity in highest-burden areas.
outcome: Adopted with the budget. Effect claims stay Needs-verification until the SAPS quarter is attached.

title: Review refuse collection capacity against rising service requests
context: Refuse service requests have risen for consecutive periods; capacity review was due before budget adoption.
